en.s: The Battle of Marcellae (Bulgarian: Битката при Маркели; Greek: Μάχη των Μαρκελλών) was fought on the 20 July 792 between the forces of the Byzantine Empire, led by Constantine VI, and those of the First Bulgarian Empire under Kardam. The Byzantines were routed and forced to retreat to Constantinople. Fighting took place at Marcellae (Markeli), near the modern town of Karnobat in southeastern Bulgaria, the same site as an earlier battle in 756.

zh.s: 马尔凯莱战役（保加利亚语：Битката при Маркели；希腊语：Μάχη των Μαρκελλών）于792年7月20日爆发。交战双方是君士坦丁六世率领的拜占庭帝国军队和卡尔达姆率领的第一保加利亚帝国军队。拜占庭军惨败，被迫撤退到君士坦丁堡。战斗发生在马尔凯莱（马尔凯利）附近，即今保加利亚东南部卡尔诺巴特镇附近；756年该处也曾发生过一场战役。

en.s: The Battle of Gunnislake New Bridge took place on 20 July 1644 on and around Gunnislake New Bridge, a bridge over the River Tamar between Cornwall and Devon, during the First English Civil War.

zh.s: 冈尼斯莱克新桥战役于1644年7月20日在第一次英国内战期间爆发，战斗发生在塔马河上的冈尼斯莱克新桥及其周边。该桥位于康沃尔郡和德文郡之间。

en.s: The Battle of Inverkeithing was a battle of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. It was fought on 20 July 1651 between an English Parliamentarian army under John Lambert and a Scottish Covenanter army acting on behalf of Charles II, led by Sir John Brown of Fordell. Lambert's force was a seaborne expedition landed at Fife to get around the main Scottish position at Stirling. The battle resulted in a decisive English victory that gave Oliver Cromwell's forces control of the Firth of Forth and outflanked the defensive position of the main Scottish Army under David Leslie.

zh.s: 因弗基辛战役是三国之战期间的一场战斗，于1651年7月20日爆发。约翰·兰伯特率领的英格兰议会军与代表查理二世作战的苏格兰圣约派军队交战；后者由福德尔的约翰·布朗爵士指挥。兰伯特率部乘船登陆法夫，绕过苏格兰军在斯特灵的主力阵地。英军取得决定性胜利，使奥利弗·克伦威尔的部队控制了福斯湾，并从侧翼包抄大卫·莱斯利指挥的苏格兰主力防线。

en.s: The Battle of Czarny Ostrów took place on July 20, 1657, during the period in Polish history known as the Deluge. Polish Crown army commanded by Hetmans Stefan Czarniecki, Jerzy Lubomirski and Stanisław Potocki, supported by Crimean Tatars, defeated a Transilvanian-Cossack-Moldavian-Wallachian army of George II Rakoczi. In early 1657, following the Treaty of Radnot, southern Poland was invaded by Transilvanian army of George II Rakoczi. Since main Polish forces of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth were engaged in fighting the Swedish Empire, only a division of Stanisław Potocki was sent southwards. Meanwhile, Rakoczi’s army headed towards Kraków, and its march was marked by widespread looting and destruction.

zh.t: 乔尔内奥斯特罗夫战役
zh.s: 乔尔内奥斯特罗夫战役于1657年7月20日在波兰史上所称的“大洪水”时期爆发。斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基、耶日·卢博米尔斯基和斯坦尼斯瓦夫·波托茨基率领波兰王冠军，并得到克里米亚鞑靼人支援，击败了乔治二世·拉科齐率领的特兰西瓦尼亚—哥萨克—摩尔达维亚—瓦拉几亚联军。1657年初，《拉德诺特条约》签订后，拉科齐的特兰西瓦尼亚军入侵波兰南部。当时波兰—立陶宛联邦主力正与瑞典帝国交战，只派斯坦尼斯瓦夫·波托茨基的一支部队南下。与此同时，拉科齐军队向克拉科夫进军，沿途大肆掠夺和破坏。

en.s: The great Oulu fire of 1705 was a conflagration that destroyed the parts of the city of Oulu, Finland. It consists of two fires in total, the first of which occurred on 20 July 1705, and the second on 28 August of the same year. A total of 144 houses and 121 granaries from the third and fourth districts of the city burned down in the fires.

zh.s: 1705年奥卢大火烧毁了芬兰奥卢市的部分城区。火灾由两场大火组成，第一场发生在1705年7月20日，第二场发生在同年8月28日。城区第三和第四区共有144栋房屋和121座粮仓被烧毁。

en.s: The siege of Nauplia took place on 12–20 July 1715, when the Ottoman Empire captured the city of Nauplia (Napoli di Romagna), the capital of the Republic of Venice's "Kingdom of the Morea" in southern Greece. Although Nauplia was strongly fortified and had been further strengthened with the construction of Palamidi fortress by the Venetians, the Ottomans managed to overcome them.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥斯曼帝国于1715年7月12日至20日围攻并攻占了纳夫普利翁（又称罗马尼亚的纳波利），该城是威尼斯共和国在希腊南部“摩里亚王国”的首府。尽管纳夫普利翁设防严密，威尼斯军队还建造了帕拉米迪堡加强防御，奥斯曼军队仍攻克了城防。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of St. Augustine was a military engagement that took place during June–July 1740. It involved a British attack on the city of St. Augustine in Spanish Florida and was a part of the much larger conflict known as the War of Jenkins' Ear.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 圣奥古斯丁围城战是1740年6月至7月发生的一场军事交战。英军袭击西属佛罗里达的圣奥古斯丁市；这场战斗是更大规模的詹金斯耳朵战争的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Capture of Turtle Bay Depot was a military raid that took place in the early American Revolutionary War on July 20, 1775. The raid was on Turtle Bay Depot, a British magazine and storehouse. On the night of July 20, 1775, a raid, conducted by the Sons of Liberty and led by Marinus Willett, John Lamb, Isaac Sears, and Alexander McDougall, attacked the Turtle Bay Depot in Manhattan, New York.

zh.s: 1775年7月20日晚，自由之子组织的队伍突袭了曼哈顿的龟湾仓库。这座仓库由英国军队用来存放军需物资。此次行动由马里纳斯·威利特、约翰·兰姆、艾萨克·西尔斯和亚历山大·麦克杜格尔带领。

en.s: The Battle of Island Flats (also the Battle at Long Island of the Holston) was the opening battle of the American War of Independence in the west. The battle was fought in July 1776, and pitted the American regional Patriot militia against the British allied Cherokee forces in the Overmountain region of the American frontier.

zh.s: 岛屿平地战役又称霍尔斯顿河长岛战役，是美国独立战争西部战场的开幕战。这场战斗于1776年7月20日在美国边疆的山地地区爆发，交战双方是美国爱国者地方民兵和英国盟友切罗基人军队。

en.s: On July 20, 1790, Habsburg forces broke into Cetin Castle in present-day Croatia after a siege that began on June 22. The castle was set on fire, and surviving Ottoman troops surrendered or fled.
en.n: This records the capture of the castle, rather than the end of the wider military campaign.

zh.t: 哈布斯堡军队攻占切廷城堡
zh.s: 1790年7月20日，哈布斯堡军队在围攻近一个月后，突破切廷城堡的城墙。城堡位于今克罗地亚，围城从6月22日开始。攻入城堡的军队纵火，幸存的奥斯曼守军有的投降，有的逃走。
zh.n: 此条记录为城堡被攻占，周边更大范围的军事行动后来仍在继续。

en.s: The Vietnamese Civil War of 1787–1802, or the Tây Sơn–Nguyễn Civil War of 1787–1802, was a conflict fought between two Vietnamese factions, the Tayson in the north, and the Nguyen loyalists in the south, both intended to unify the realm. Following the Tây Sơn rebellion (1771–1789), the kingdom of Dai Viet was partitioned into three regions ruled by the Tây Sơn brothers Nguyen Nhac, Nguyen Hue and Nguyen Lu.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 越南1787—1802年内战又称西山—阮氏1787—1802年内战，是越南北方西山派与南方阮氏拥护者之间的冲突，双方都意在统一国家。西山起义（1771—1789年）后，大越国分裂为三个地区，分别由西山兄弟阮岳、阮惠和阮禄统治。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Citizens of Bogotá, New Granada declare independence from Spain
en.s: The Viceroyalty of the New Kingdom of Granada (Spanish: Virreinato del Nuevo Reino de Granada [birejˈnato ðel ˈnweβo ˈrejno ðe ɣɾaˈnaða]), also called Viceroyalty of New Granada (Virreinato de la Nueva Granada) or Viceroyalty of Santa Fe, was the name given on 27 May 1717 to the jurisdiction of the Spanish Empire in northern South America, corresponding to modern Colombia, Ecuador, Panama and Venezuela.

zh.t: 新格拉纳达波哥大市民宣布脱离西班牙独立
zh.s: 新格拉纳达王国总督辖区（西班牙语：Virreinato del Nuevo Reino de Granada [birejˈnato ðel ˈnweβo ˈrejno ðe ɣɾaˈnaða]），也称新格拉纳达总督辖区（Virreinato de la Nueva Granada）或圣菲总督辖区，是西班牙帝国于1717年5月27日设立的南美洲北部管辖区，范围相当于今天的哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、巴拿马和委内瑞拉。

en.s: A skirmish at Tegalreja, the estate of Yogyakartan Prince Diponegoro, took place on 20 July 1825. The incident took place following a Dutch–Yogyakartan attempt to capture Diponegoro in order to prevent a brewing rebellion, which had in turn been incited by a government road project. The Dutch–Yogyakartan force failed to capture Diponegoro, who would escape to Selarong and trigger the Java War for the next five years.

zh.s: 1825年7月20日，荷兰军队和日惹方面在日惹王子迪波内戈罗的庄园特加尔雷贾发生小规模冲突。冲突起因是荷兰—日惹联军试图抓捕迪波内戈罗，以阻止一场正在酝酿的叛乱；这场叛乱则由政府道路工程项目引发。联军未能抓住迪波内戈罗。他逃往塞拉隆，并由此引发持续5年的爪哇战争。

en.s: The Java War (Javanese: ꦥꦼꦫꦁꦗꦮ; Dutch: De Java-oorlog; Indonesian: Perang Jawa), also known in Indonesia as the Diponegoro War (Javanese: ꦥꦼꦫꦁꦢꦶꦥꦤꦼꦒꦫ; Indonesian: Perang Diponegoro), was an armed conflict in central and eastern Java from 1825 to 1830, between native Javanese rebels headed by Prince Diponegoro and the Dutch East Indies supported by Javanese princely states. It is considered a watershed in Javanese history, culture, and society.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 爪哇战争（爪哇语：ꦥꦼꦫꦁꦗꦮ；荷兰语：De Java-oorlog；印度尼西亚语：Perang Jawa）也称迪波内戈罗战争（爪哇语：ꦥꦼꦫꦁꦢꦶꦥꦤꦼꦒꦫ；印度尼西亚语：Perang Diponegoro），是1825年至1830年间发生在爪哇中部和东部的一场武装冲突。冲突一方是迪波内戈罗王子领导的爪哇本土叛军，另一方是荷属东印度政府及其爪哇王公盟友。这场战争被视为爪哇历史、文化和社会发展的转折点。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Tura was fought around the village of Tura by the cavalry of the IX. and the X. corps of the Hungarian revolutionary army led by General Mór Perczel and the Russian cavalry detachment led by Lieutenant General Aleksandr Petrovich Tolstoy and the 1. brigade of the 5. infantry division led by Lieutenant General Ivan Mikhaylovich Labintsov.

zh.s: 图拉战役发生在图拉村附近，交战双方是匈牙利革命军和俄罗斯军队。匈牙利第九和第十军团的骑兵由莫尔·佩尔采尔将军率领；俄军由亚历山大·彼得罗维奇·托尔斯泰中将率领的骑兵支队，以及伊万·米哈伊洛维奇·拉宾佐夫中将指挥的第五步兵师第一旅组成。

en.s: The Battle of Devil's River was an 1857 Indian War skirmish which took place in Texas along the Devils River. A small force of United States Army cavalry defeated an overwhelming force of Comanche braves after an epic journey across the desert.

zh.s: 魔鬼河战役是1857年印第安战争期间发生在得克萨斯州魔鬼河附近的一场小规模冲突。美国陆军一支小规模骑兵部队经过漫长的沙漠行军后，击败了人数占压倒性优势的科曼奇族战士。

en.s: The Battle of Peachtree Creek was fought in Georgia on July 20, 1864, as part of the Atlanta Campaign in the American Civil War. It was the first major attack by Lt. Gen. John Bell Hood since taking command of the Confederate Army of Tennessee. The attack was against Maj. Gen. William T. Sherman's Union army which was perched on the doorstep of Atlanta. The main armies in the conflict were the Union Army of the Cumberland, commanded by Maj. Gen. George Henry Thomas, and two corps of the Confederate Army of Tennessee, commanded by Lt. Gen. John B. Hood.

zh.s: 桃树溪战役于1864年7月20日在佐治亚州爆发，是美国南北战争亚特兰大战役的一部分。这是约翰·贝尔·胡德中将接掌南方邦联田纳西军团后发动的首次大规模进攻。胡德的部队攻击了威廉·T·谢尔曼少将指挥的联邦军；谢尔曼的部队当时已逼近亚特兰大。战役中的主力部队包括乔治·亨利·托马斯少将指挥的坎伯兰联邦军，以及胡德中将指挥的南方邦联田纳西军团两个军。

en.s: The Battle of Rutherford's Farm, also known as Carter's Farm and Stephenson's Depot, was a small engagement between Confederate forces under Maj. Gen. Stephen D. Ramseur and Union forces under Brig. Gen. William W. Averell on July 20, 1864, in Frederick County, Virginia, during the American Civil War, as part of Confederate Lt. Gen. Jubal Early's Valley Campaign, resulting in a Union victory.

zh.s: 卢瑟福农场战役又称卡特农场战役或史蒂文森车站战役，于1864年7月20日在美国南北战争期间爆发，地点在弗吉尼亚州弗雷德里克县。该战役是朱巴尔·厄尔利中将谷地战役的一部分。交战双方是斯蒂芬·D·拉姆瑟少将率领的南方邦联军和威廉·W·阿弗雷尔准将率领的联邦军，最终联邦军获胜。

en.t: Capture of the North Frisian Islands
en.s: The capture of the North Frisian Islands and Rømø in July 1864 was the last military operation of the Second Schleswig War between Denmark and Prussia and the Austrian Empire around the duchies of Schleswig and Holstein, which belonged to Denmark. It ended with the occupation of the North Frisian Islands and Rømø by Austrian troops.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1864年7月，奥地利军队占领北弗里斯兰群岛和罗姆岛。这是第二次石勒苏益格战争的最后一场军事行动。战争由丹麦、普鲁士和奥地利帝国围绕石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因两公国展开；这两地当时属于丹麦。行动以奥军占领北弗里斯兰群岛和罗姆岛告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On July 20, 1866, the Austrian and Italian navies fought near Lissa, now Vis in Croatia, during the Third Italian War of Independence. Wilhelm von Tegetthoff’s Austrian fleet defeated the Italian fleet led by Carlo Pellion di Persano.

zh.s: 1866年7月20日，奥地利和意大利海军在利萨岛附近交战。该岛现称维斯岛，属于克罗地亚。威廉·冯·特格特霍夫率领的奥地利舰队击败了卡洛·佩利翁·迪·佩尔萨诺指挥的意大利舰队。

en.s: Uruguay 0–6 Argentina was an association football match between Uruguay and Argentina in 1902. It was the first international match for both sides, and also the first international held in South America. Argentina won 6–0, initiating a longtime rivalry between both teams, that have met more than 190 times since that first encounter, becoming the international derby with the most matches played worldwide, surpassing even the England–Scotland rivalry, which, first held in 1872, is the oldest fixture in the world.

zh.t: 1902年乌拉圭对阵阿根廷足球赛
zh.s: 1902年乌拉圭以0比6负于阿根廷。这场足球赛是两队各自的首场国际比赛，也是南美洲举行的首场国际比赛。阿根廷以6比0获胜，两队由此展开长期竞争；自首次交锋以来，双方交手超过190次，成为全球交手次数最多的国家队对决，甚至超过了1872年首次举行、历史最悠久的英格兰对苏格兰比赛。

en.s: The Attack at Fromelles (French pronunciation: [fʁɔmɛl] (Battle of Fromelles, Battle of Fleurbaix or Schlacht von Fromelles) was a military operation on the Western Front during the First World War on 19–20 July 1916. The attack was carried out by British and Australian troops and was subsidiary to the Battle of the Somme.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 弗罗梅勒攻势又称弗勒尔贝战役或弗罗梅勒战役，是第一次世界大战期间西线于1916年7月19日至20日展开的一次军事行动。英军和澳大利亚军队发动了进攻，这是索姆河战役的一次配合作战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On July 20, 1917, Serbian prime minister Nikola Pašić and Yugoslav Committee president Ante Trumbić concluded the Corfu Declaration on the Greek island of Corfu. The agreement set out plans for a common South Slavic state after the First World War.
en.n: July 20 is the Gregorian date; the corresponding Julian date was July 7.

zh.s: 1917年7月20日，塞尔维亚首相尼古拉·帕希奇与南斯拉夫委员会主席安特·特鲁姆比奇在希腊科孚岛达成《科孚宣言》，为第一次世界大战后建立共同的南斯拉夫国家提出方案。
zh.n: 此处采用公历7月20日，对应当时儒略历7月7日。

en.s: The First Battle of Grodno took place between July 19 and July 20, 1920, during the Polish-Soviet War. In the effect of a three-day-long struggle for the control of the city of Grodno (modern Hrodna, Belarus), the town was captured by Russian forces, despite repeated counter-attacks by Polish infantry, tanks and armoured trains.

zh.t: 格罗德诺第一次战役（1920年）
zh.s: 格罗德诺第一次战役发生于1920年7月19日至20日，是波苏战争的一部分。双方为争夺格罗德诺市（今白俄罗斯格罗德诺）进行了三天的战斗。尽管波兰步兵、坦克和装甲列车多次反击，俄军最终仍攻占了该城。

en.s: On July 20, 1925, Druze rebels led by Sultan Pasha al-Atrash entered Salkhad, in present-day Syria. The French Mandate garrison surrendered without significant resistance. The capture was one of the opening events of the Great Syrian Revolt; rebels had shot down a French reconnaissance aircraft the day before.
en.n: The aircraft incident occurred on July 19; the capture of the town followed on July 20.

zh.t: 德鲁兹起义军攻占萨勒赫德

en.t: Montreux Convention Regarding the Regime of the Straits
en.s: The Montreux Convention Regarding the Regime of the Straits is a 1936 agreement that gives Turkey control over the Bosporus Straits and the Dardanelles and regulates the transit of naval warships. The Convention gives Turkey full control over the Straits and guarantees the free passage of civilian vessels in peacetime. It restricts the passage of naval ships not belonging to Black Sea states. The terms of the convention have been the source of controversy over the years, most notably concerning the Soviet Union's military access to the Mediterranean Sea. Signed on 20 July 1936 at the Montreux Palace in Switzerland, it permitted Turkey to remilitarise the Straits.

zh.s: 《蒙特勒海峡制度公约》是1936年签署的一项协议，赋予土耳其对博斯普鲁斯海峡和达达尼尔海峡的控制权，并规定军舰通行规则。公约将海峡完全置于土耳其控制之下，同时保证和平时期民用船只可自由通行，并限制非黑海国家军舰通过。多年来，公约条款一直存在争议，尤其是苏联军队进入地中海的问题。公约于1936年7月20日在瑞士蒙特勒宫签署，允许土耳其恢复对海峡的军事部署。

en.s: The Battle of Bairoko was a battle between American and Imperial Japanese Army and Navy forces on 20 July 1943 during the New Georgia Campaign in the Solomon Islands during the Pacific War. In the battle, U.S. Marine Raiders—supported by two U.S. Army infantry battalions—attacked a Japanese garrison guarding the port of Bairoko on the Dragons Peninsula on New Georgia. The day-long assault on well-prepared Japanese defensive positions by the Americans was unsuccessful. After calling-off the assault, the Americans withdrew to nearby Enogai. The American forces remained in the Enogai area until the end of the New Georgia Campaign.

zh.s: 1943年7月20日，拜罗科战役在太平洋战争期间爆发，是所罗门群岛新乔治亚岛战役的一部分，交战双方为美军和日本帝国陆海军。美国海军陆战队突击队在两个美国陆军步兵营支援下，攻击了驻守新乔治亚岛德拉贡半岛拜罗科港的日军。美军当天对准备充分的日军阵地发动进攻，但未能成功。美军取消进攻后撤往附近的埃诺盖，并留在该地区直至新乔治亚岛战役结束。

en.s: Operation Goodwood was a British offensive in the Second World War, that took place between 18 and 20 July 1944 as part of the battle for Caen in Normandy, France. Goodwood was preceded by preliminary attacks dubbed the Second Battle of the Odon. The offensive began when the British VIII Corps, with three armoured divisions, attacked to seize the German-held Bourguébus Ridge and the area between Bretteville-sur-Laize and Vimont and to inflict as much attrition on the German defenders as possible.

zh.s: 古德伍德行动是第二次世界大战期间英国军队于1944年7月18日至20日发动的一次攻势，属于法国诺曼底卡昂战役的一部分。攻势前有一系列前奏攻击，合称第二次奥东河战役。行动开始时，英国第八军团出动3个装甲师，攻击德军控制的布尔格埃比斯山脊，以及布雷特维尔拉莱兹与维蒙之间的地区，并尽可能消耗德军守军。

en.s: The 20 July plot, sometimes referred to as Operation Valkyrie (German: Unternehmen Walküre), was a failed attempt to assassinate Adolf Hitler, the dictator of Nazi Germany, and overthrow the Nazi government on 20 July 1944. The plotters were part of the German resistance, mainly composed of Wehrmacht officers. The principal mastermind of the conspiracy, Claus von Stauffenberg, tried to kill Hitler by detonating an explosive hidden in a briefcase.

zh.s: 7月20日密谋又称“瓦尔基里行动”（德语：Unternehmen Walküre），是德国抵抗组织于1944年7月20日企图刺杀纳粹德国独裁者阿道夫·希特勒并推翻纳粹政府的一次未遂行动。参与密谋者主要是德国国防军军官。阴谋的主要策划者克劳斯·冯·施陶芬贝格试图引爆藏在公文包里的炸弹杀死希特勒。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in South Korea for the first time on 20 July 1948, following the Constitutional Assembly elections earlier that year. The elections were indirect, with the president elected by the Assembly. Syngman Rhee was elected with 180 votes out of 196, and was to oversee the transfer of power from the United States Army Military Government in Korea. An important role was played in the run-up to the election by the dispute between Rhee and Kim Koo over the issue of holding separate elections in the South.

zh.s: 韩国于1948年7月20日首次举行总统选举，此前同年已举行制宪议会选举。本次为间接选举，由议会选出总统。李承晚获得196票中的180票当选，负责监督权力从驻韩美国陆军军政府移交。选举前，李承晚与金九围绕是否在韩国单独举行选举的争议发挥了重要影响。

en.t: King Abdullah I of Jordan is assassinated by a Palestinian while attending Friday prayers in Jerusalem
en.s: Abdullah I (Abdullah bin Hussein; 2 February 1882 – 20 July 1951) was the ruler of Jordan from 11 April 1921 until his assassination in 1951. He was the Emir of Transjordan, a British protectorate, until 25 May 1946, after which he was king of an independent Jordan. As a member of the Hashemite dynasty, the royal family of Jordan since 1921, Abdullah was a 38th-generation direct descendant of Muhammad.

en.s: Special Olympics is the world's largest sports organization for children and adults with intellectual disabilities, providing year-round training and activities to 5 million participants and Unified Sports partners in 172 countries and territories. Special Olympics events are held daily, in all levels including local, national regional and global competitions, adding up to more than 100,000 events a year. Like the International Paralympic Committee, the Special Olympics organization is recognized by the International Olympic Committee; however, unlike the Paralympic Games, its World Games are not held in the same year nor in conjunction with the Olympic Games. The Special Olympics World Games is a major event put on by the Special Olympics committee. The World Games generally alternate between summer and winter games, in two-year cycles, recurring every fourth year. The games were first held on July 20, 1968, in Chicago, Illinois, United States, with about 1,000 athletes from the U.S. and Canada.

zh.s: 特殊奥林匹克运动会是世界上规模最大的智力障碍儿童和成人体育组织，为172个国家和地区的500万名参与者及融合体育伙伴提供全年训练和活动。特奥赛事每天都在各级别举行，包括地方、国家、区域和全球赛事，每年总计超过100,000场。与国际残疾人奥林匹克委员会类似，特奥组织也获国际奥委会认可；但与残奥会不同，特奥世界运动会并不与奥运会同年或同期举行。特奥世界运动会是由特奥委员会举办的重要赛事，通常在夏季和冬季运动会之间交替，每两年一届，每四年轮换一类。首届特奥会于1968年7月20日在美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥举行，约有1,000名来自美国和加拿大的运动员参赛。

en.s: The Apollo 11 lunar module Eagle landed in the Moon's Sea of Tranquility with Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin aboard. Michael Collins remained in lunar orbit in the command module Columbia. The landing fulfilled the mission's central objective and was followed several hours later by humanity's first steps on the lunar surface. Armstrong and Aldrin collected samples, deployed experiments, and returned safely to the command module. The mission was a landmark in space exploration and the culmination of years of engineering and training. The lunar landing occurred on July 20 in UTC; Armstrong's first step occurred on July 21 in UTC.
en.n: Landing: July 20 UTC. First step: July 21 UTC. The place filter identifies Mission Control, not the Moon.

zh.s: “鹰”号登月舱载着尼尔·阿姆斯特朗和巴兹·奥尔德林降落在月球静海。迈克尔·柯林斯留在月球轨道上的“哥伦比亚”号指令舱内。登月实现了任务的核心目标，数小时后，人类首次踏上月球表面。阿姆斯特朗和奥尔德林采集了月壤样本、部署科学实验设备，随后安全返回指令舱。这次登月是太空探索史上的里程碑，也是多年工程研发和训练的成果。按协调世界时计算，登月发生在7月20日，阿姆斯特朗首次踏上月面则是7月21日。

en.s: The Turkish invasion of Cyprus was a Turkish military invasion of the island country of Cyprus. It was launched on 20 July 1974, following the Cypriot coup d'état on 15 July 1974. The coup had been ordered by the military Junta in Greece and staged by the Cypriot National Guard in conjunction with EOKA-B. It deposed the Cypriot president Archbishop Makarios III and installed pro-Enosis Nikos Sampson. The aim of the coup was the annexation of the island by Greece and the Hellenic Republic of Cyprus was declared. In July 1974, Turkish forces invaded and captured 3% of the island before a ceasefire was declared.

zh.s: 土耳其入侵塞浦路斯是土耳其对塞浦路斯岛国发动的一次军事入侵，始于1974年7月20日。此前，希腊军政府于7月15日下令，塞浦路斯国民警卫队与EOKA-B合作发动政变。政变推翻塞浦路斯总统、总主教马卡里奥斯三世，拥立支持希腊并吞塞浦路斯的尼科斯·桑普森。政变目标是由希腊吞并该岛，并宣布成立塞浦路斯希腊共和国。1974年7月，土军入侵并占领了该岛3%的地区，随后宣布停火。

en.s: Viking 1 is the first of two spacecraft, along with Viking 2, each consisting of an orbiter and a lander, sent to Mars as part of NASA's Viking program. The lander touched down on Mars on July 20, 1976, the first successful Mars lander in history. Viking 1 operated on Mars for 2,307 days (over 61⁄4 years) or 2245 Martian solar days, the longest extraterrestrial surface mission until the record was broken by the Opportunity rover on May 19, 2010.

zh.s: 海盗1号是“海盗计划”派往火星的两艘航天器之一，另一艘为海盗2号；每艘航天器都由轨道器和着陆器组成。海盗1号着陆器于1976年7月20日降落火星，成为历史上首个成功登陆火星的探测器。它在火星运行2,307个地球日（超过6¼年），或2,245个火星太阳日；直到2010年5月19日，机遇号火星车才打破其地外星球表面任务持续时间纪录。

en.s: On 20 July 1981, Somali Airlines Flight 40, a Fokker F27-600 Friendship operating a daily scheduled domestic passenger flight from Mogadishu International Airport to Hargeisa Airport, Somalia, crashed near the town of Balad a few minutes after takeoff killing all 44 passengers and 6 crew members on board. zh.t: 索马里航空40号班机空难
zh.s: 1981年7月20日，索马里航空40号班机在从摩加迪沙国际机场飞往索马里哈尔格萨机场的每日定期国内客运航班途中坠毁。飞机是一架福克F27-600“友谊”型客机，起飞几分钟后在巴拉德镇附近坠毁，机上44名乘客和6名机组人员全部遇难，共造成50人死亡。这仍是索马里死亡人数最多的航空事故。

en.t: Hyde Park and Regent's Park bombings
en.s: The Hyde Park and Regent's Park bombings were carried out on 20 July 1982 in London, England. Members of the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) detonated two improvised explosive devices during British military ceremonies in Hyde Park and Regent's Park, both in central London. The explosions killed eleven military personnel: four soldiers of the Blues and Royals at Hyde Park, and seven bandsmen of the Royal Green Jackets at Regent's Park.

en.s: On 20 July 1992, a Tupolev Tu-154B cargo plane crashed during takeoff from Tbilisi-Novo Alexeyevka Airport in Georgia. The aircraft failed to become airborne and struck a residential area, killing all 24 on board and four more people on the ground. An investigation revealed that the aircraft's cargo was improperly loaded and partially undocumented, causing it to become overloaded.

en.t: Václav Havel resigns as president of Czechoslovakia
en.s: Václav Havel (Czech: [ˈvaːt͡slav ˈɦavɛl] ; 5 October 1936 – 18 December 2011) was a Czech statesman, author, poet, playwright, and dissident. Havel served as the last president of Czechoslovakia from 1989 until 1992, prior to the dissolution of Czechoslovakia on 31 December, before he became the first president of the Czech Republic from 1993 to 2003. He was the first democratically elected president of either country after the fall of communism.

zh.t: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔辞去捷克斯洛伐克总统职务
zh.s: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔（捷克语：[ˈvaːt͡slav ˈɦavɛl]；1936年10月5日—2011年12月18日）是捷克政治家、作家、诗人、剧作家和异议人士。1989年至1992年捷克斯洛伐克解体前，他担任该国最后一任总统；1992年12月31日捷克斯洛伐克解体后，他于1993年至2003年担任捷克共和国首任总统。他是共产主义垮台后两国首位通过民主选举产生的总统。

en.t: North Carolina's 1st congressional district special election, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives special election in North Carolina's 1st congressional district was held on July 20, 2004 to select the successor to Frank Ballance (D) who resigned due to health concerns and ongoing investigations which would ultimately culminate in criminal convictions on charges of committing money laundering and mail fraud. Each party held a nominating convention to choose their nominee for the special election. Democrats nominated Superior Court Judge and former State Supreme Court Associate Justice G. K. en.s: K-1 World MAX 2005 Championship Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the fourth K-1 World MAX final for middleweight kickboxers (70 kg/152 lb weight class), involving eight finalists and two reserve fighters, with all bouts fought under K-1 rules. All eight of the finalists had won elimination fights at the K-1 World MAX 2005 World Tournament Open, while the reserve fighters were invited despite suffering defeats. As well as tournament matches there were also three super fights fought under K-1 rules (70 kg/152 lb weight class). In total there were sixteen fighters at the event, representing nine countries. The tournament winner was shoot boxing standout Andy Souwer who defeated reigning champion and tournament favorite Buakaw Por. Pramuk by split decision in a grueling final that went into two extension rounds. Souwer was helped in his route to the final by the fact that local hero (and one of the favorites) Masato was injured in his quarter final match and replaced by the much less renowned Yasuhiro Kazuya, who had suffered a cut in his reserve match win, something Souwer took full advantage of, winning by technical knockout. In the super fights the most notable result saw legendary Muay Thai champion Ramon Dekkers outclass former K-1 USA winner Duane Ludwig, winning via a wide unanimous decision. The event was held in Yokohama, Japan at the Yokohama Arena on Wednesday, July 20, 2005.

zh.s: K-1 World MAX 2005年总决赛是K-1组织举办的一场踢拳赛事，也是中量级（70公斤／152磅）拳手参加的第4届K-1 World MAX决赛。赛事有8名决赛选手和2名候补选手，所有比赛均按K-1规则进行。8名决赛选手都在K-1 World MAX 2005年世界公开赛的淘汰赛中胜出；尽管候补选手此前遭遇败绩，他们仍获邀参赛。除锦标赛对阵外，赛事还安排了3场同为70公斤级、按K-1规则进行的超级战。赛事共聚集16名选手，代表9个国家。踢拳击拳选手安迪·苏沃尔在一场艰苦的决赛中经过两轮加时，以分歧判定击败卫冕冠军兼夺冠热门播求·波·巴育，夺得冠军。苏沃尔得以前进至决赛，部分原因是当地名将、夺冠热门正道在四分之一决赛中受伤，随后由名气较小的安田康和替补；安田此前在候补赛获胜时头部受伤。苏沃尔抓住机会，以技术性击倒获胜。超级战中最受瞩目的比赛之一是传奇泰拳冠军拉蒙·德克斯击败前K-1美国冠军杜安·路德维希，取得压倒性的全体裁判一致判定胜利。赛事于2005年7月20日（星期三）在日本横滨的横滨竞技场举行。

en.s: The Syrian civil war was an armed conflict that began with the Syrian revolution in March 2011, when popular discontent with the Ba'athist regime ruled by Bashar al-Assad triggered large-scale protests and pro-democracy rallies across Syria, as part of the wider Arab Spring. en.s: The 2014 Belgian Super Cup is a football match that was played on 20 July 2014, between 2013–14 Belgian Pro League winners Anderlecht and 2013–14 Belgian Cup winners Lokeren, won by Anderlecht, winning their twelfth super cup. Anderlecht had played in eighteen previous editions of the Belgian Super Cup, winning in 1985, 1987, 1993, 1995, 2000, 2001, 2006, 2007, 2010, 2012 and their most recent appearance in 2013. Lokeren had played in a Belgian Super Cup once before, two years previous in 2012, also facing Anderlecht and losing 3-2.

zh.s: 2014年比利时超级杯于2014年7月20日举行，由2013—14赛季比利时职业联赛冠军安德莱赫特对阵比利时杯冠军洛克伦。安德莱赫特获胜，赢得队史第12座超级杯。安德莱赫特此前参加过18届比利时超级杯，曾于1985、1987、1993、1995、2000、2001、2006、2007、2010、2012和2013年夺冠。洛克伦此前只参加过一次超级杯，即2012年对阵安德莱赫特，当时以2比3落败。
